items.title: Pixie Dust Wi-Fi Attack Exploits Routers WPS to Obtain PIN and Connect With Wireless Network
items.description: The newly publicized Pixie Dust attack has once again exposed the critical vulnerabilities inherent in the Wi-Fi Protected Setup (WPS) protocol, enabling attackers to extract the router’s WPS PIN offline and seamlessly join the wireless network.
